sources.title: https://bellevuewa.gov/city-government/departments/utilities/manage-your-utility-services/wastewater
sources.supports: Bellevue Wastewater: City maintains mains and service connections in ROW/easements; emergency backup line 425-452-7840; slow drainage likely side sewer, call private service; location info 425-452-4187; no private locates

sources.title: https://bellevuewa.gov/city-government/departments/development/permits/faqs/work-requiring-permits
sources.supports: Bellevue work requiring permits: side sewer permit for minor repair, replacement, revision, added connection; clearing and grading permit may apply to long runs/large excavations

sources.title: https://bellevuewa.gov/city-government/departments/development/permits/utilities-permits/side-sewer-permit
sources.supports: Bellevue Side Sewer Permit: apply via MyBuildingPermit; required and additional documents; Utility Review contact

sources.title: https://bellevuewa.gov/city-government/departments/utilities/utilities-projects-plans-standards/utilities-codes-and-standards/side-sewer-permit-conditions
sources.supports: Side Sewer Permit Conditions: preconstruction meeting code 630; 811; no backfill before inspection; crushed rock bedding; restoration; easement notice; ROW PVC SDR 35, separate ROW permit; couplings; final and re-inspection within 7 days

sources.title: https://bellevuewa.gov/city-government/departments/utilities/utilities-projects-plans-standards/utilities-codes-and-standards/side-sewer-permit-conditions/relining-side-sewers
sources.supports: Relining side sewers: ASTM F1216; manufacturer license/certified installers; cleaning; CCTV; protrusion check; as-built update; deficiency notice; no line/grade change

sources.title: https://bellevuewa.gov/city-government/departments/utilities/utilities-projects-plans-standards/utilities-codes-and-standards/side-sewer-permit-conditions/pipe-bursting
sources.supports: Pipe bursting: HDPE 24-hour rest; anchors within 3 ft; DR 26 min; 4-inch min private, 6-inch joint use; transition coupling with stiffening sleeve; post-install CCTV; mandrel; as-built

sources.title: https://bellevue.municipal.codes/BCC/24.04.115
sources.supports: BCC 24.04.115 system ownership: utility owns mains/stubs in ROW; private side sewers owned and maintained by owner incl. check valves, cleanouts, pumps

sources.title: https://bellevue.municipal.codes/BCC/24.04.120
sources.supports: BCC 24.04.120: side sewer permit required to construct or make additions, repairs, connections

sources.title: https://bellevue.municipal.codes/BCC/24.04.170
sources.supports: BCC 24.04.170: side sewers constructed only by licensed contractors or owners; permit on site; designated stub; utility installs stub if not found
